linux_x64.emulation: Docker Desktop aarch64 host; linux/amd64 Rosetta

limitations: No local single-pass corpus or bounded-concurrency experiment reproduced the original abort.
Linux Docker diagnostics use Rust1.98.1; failed and printed-diagnostic Ubuntu CI use1.98.0.
The three full-corpus binaries include printed case markers. Passing may change timing, so the next diagnostic uses one shared atomic store instead.
A corpus pass and a concurrency pass do not establish memory/thread exhaustion, decoder race, or an AVIF fix. Issue535 remains unresolved.
No production decoder, dependency, frame budget, resource limit, fixture, retry policy or coverage threshold was changed.

production_fix.decode: n_threads=1, max_frame_delay=1, inside catch_unwind; a decoder panic is a broken image
production_fix.root_cause_note: The original CI panic message was never captured, so the exact panicking site for run 44418005980 is unknown; the fix removes the abort mechanism for every rav1d panic and the worker threads/async close that made it timing-dependent.

published_decoder.name: rav1d
published_decoder.source_verified: All locally cached archive files match the published .crate, not just the four lifecycle sources.

concurrency.corruption: Overwrite the second half of the color OBU payload with 0xff in place; all container bytes and lengths otherwise unchanged.

original_failure.outcome: child exited with SIGABRT/status134; first12 stderr lines hid the cause

printed_diagnostic.outcome: raster passed; this does not establish a decoder fix

rusty_av1d_1.3.0.decision: Rejected: historical frame_hdr unwrap, spawn unwrap, and asynchronous close all remain.

re_rav1d_0.1.3.provenance: The published archive checksum matches official registry metadata; embedded VCS SHA matches the public re_rav1d branch. Repository archived June9,2026.
re_rav1d_0.1.3.api: Existing include::dav1d and src::lib C API paths are retained; Rust header files match1.1.0. ASM-off supported by cfg(feature=asm) build.rs guard.
re_rav1d_0.1.3.historical_fix: on_error uses frame_hdr.as_ref().is_some_and at decode.rs4997-5000, equivalent to upstream PR1503. Single context avoids worker spawn and async shutdown.
re_rav1d_0.1.3.decision: Rejected as-is: older AlignedVec lacks official1.1.0 checked allocation multiplication and alignment assertion/tests. Additional CDF, refmvs, allocator and DSP changes mean this is not simply1.1.0 plus the teardown fix.

reproduction_commands.manifest:
[package]
name="avif-concurrency-diagnosis"
version="0.0.0"
edition="2021"
[workspace]
[features]
default=["avif"]
avif=[]
[dependencies]
turbo-dom-layout={path="../../crates/turbo-dom-layout"}
rav1d={version="=1.1.0",default-features=false,features=["bitdepth_8","bitdepth_16"]}
libc="0.2"
[[bin]]
name="avif-concurrency-diagnosis"
path="../../tools/avif-diagnostics/concurrency.rs"
reproduction_commands.notes: Run from repository root inside the recorded Linux image; keep limits unchanged. This is a bounded diagnostic, not a replacement for the full corpus gate.
reproduction_commands.retained_harness_note: The retained source changes only the relative module path and one-time corrupt-input output path from the executed temporary harness; it was not used for another native run.

raw_logs: Large raw logs and temporary build targets stay ignored under /.evidence/. No raw decoder archive is committed.
